what_happened: Layout 10, green bendy straw (Straw012), GlassCup025. Stage 0 normal: drawer pulled to 1.08 by 224, complete at 221. Stage 1: straw grasped at 358-370 and lifted 0.70 m (width 0.013 hold), navigation 373-~640. From ~700 to 870 the straw was held with its straight end hanging down next to the cup and moved left of, over and right of it, never touching the cup (at_target never held). 872-944 the arm moved right/down toward the counter edge and released at 942, 0.149 m from the cup centre; the straw dropped onto the counter 0.156 m from the cup (end z 0.93) and stayed there. The policy then moved around near the stools and never re-grasped it.
causal_chain: straw at the cup ~700 (on time) -> ~170 steps of re-positioning beside/over the cup without inserting it -> moved off and released 15 cm away (942) -> straw on the counter, no retry -> timeout
official_criterion_notes: Official success = straw touches the cup AND straw centre < 0.5 m horizontally from the cup centre AND gripper far; there is no 'inside' or upright test, so a straw lying across the rim or leaning on the outside of the cup would count once the gripper leaves. Straw tilt fields are relative to the straw lying flat: 'tipped_over' (>45 deg) here means the straw was held or standing vertical, not that it fell over.
uncertain_about: Depth: from the agent view I cannot tell how close (in depth) the straw end came to the cup opening during 780-870.
